concepts.label: Warmup (node data load on restart)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the process by which a restarted node with existing data on disk reads it back into memory before serving data, distinct from server:node-recovery's full/delta recovery (which is about reintegrating a failed-over node into cluster membership, not about loading a single node's own on-disk data on restart). Placed in server: since it is a node-lifecycle mechanism, not a vBucket-, durability- or XDCR-scoped one, and no closer namespace fits. Kept as one mechanism-level concept rather than one per statistic (ep_warmup_key_count, ep_warmup_oom, etc.), per this round's warning against minting a concept per table row.

relations.subject: server:warmup
relations.evidence: Shows statistics related to the node warmup.

relations.subject: server:warmup
relations.object: warmup phase: loading keys | loading access log | done
relations.evidence: This describes which phase of warmup is currently running. Look for values: loading keys, loading access log, and done.

notable_absence.finding: The page describes warmup purely as a consequence of a node reboot or service restart finding existing data on disk, and never states whether a node undergoing server:node-recovery (full or delta recovery, already promoted) also warms up, or whether these are alternative code paths for populating memory - a reader cannot tell if the two mechanisms compose or are mutually exclusive.

cross_component_finding: Warmup's phase machine (loading keys -> loading access log -> done) shares no vocabulary with any other mechanism in this batch - no mention of DCP, checkpoints, failover logs or durability tracking - despite this round's framing centering on DCP-protocol-adjacent mechanisms. That silence is itself a finding: a node-restart data-load path exists in cbstats that is entirely orthogonal to the DCP/checkpoint/durability/failover cluster this batch otherwise covers.
cross_product_finding: Not applicable - node warmup on restart is Couchbase Server-internal KV Engine behavior with no stated Sync Gateway or Capella surface in this batch.
